prompt:
Original Taiwanese game art for "Tainan Gazetteer" (府城夜巡地圖), set in Tainan around 1930.
Style: handmade layered paper sculpture (紙雕 / kirie), the same for buildings, trees, plants,
fences, ground tiles, icons and props. Every shape is a piece of cut paper: visible paper fibres,
slightly soft hand-cut edges, pieces overlapping in shallow layers with small soft contact shadows
where one sheet sits on another. Colour is printed on the paper: clearly visible risograph /
stencil print grain and uneven ink density across every flat area, never a clean digital fill.
Add a very faint, even stencil/risograph grain and slight print misregistration; ink edges a
little imperfect. No heavy stains, blotches, cracks or overall ageing.
Weathering is welcome: irregular faded patches, not neat squares.
Details are built from few, large cut pieces (roof tiles, bricks, window frames, leaves, petals,
stones, planks), not painted lines and not crowded tiny patterns. Plants are natural and
asymmetric.
Colour: follow the real object, then mute it: pale, slightly greyed, warm. Typical tones: warm
cream, pale brick red, coral, sage and grey-green, mustard, indigo, wood brown, stone grey.
No saturated red-against-green contrast.
Buildings: strictly frontal elevation, no perspective, three or four flat paper layers.
Do NOT make: a 3D render or clay/plastic model, smooth bevelled relief, realistic or painterly
illustration, photo textures, thick foam layers, glow, glossy highlights, black outline strokes,
smooth gradients, depth of field.
Output: generated natively on a fully TRANSPARENT background (real alpha including enclosed
holes, no backdrop, no glow, no chroma-key colour, no coloured fringe), every object complete
and separated by clear transparent gutters, no ground, no base, no cast shadow outside the
object, no text, no captions, no logos.

Create ONE new menu icon for 夜巡, a round Taiwanese hand-painted paper lantern of the kind strung up at Tainan's Puji Temple lantern festival. Use the local flowerpot and bound-book input images only as references for paper texture, muted pigments, edge softness, layering, and compact menu-icon visual weight. Use a practically spherical, broad warm ivory paper body (just a little wider than high); small dark charcoal paper circular collars at both poles, a tiny short hanging cord at top with real alpha through any loop, and one short bundled tassel below. No carrying handle, no banded or striped Japanese chōchin design, no Japanese ornament, no prominent ribs. Silhouette looks round and reads immediately at 48 px. Show an original cheerful childlike hand-painted motif translated into a few big, irregular flat paper cutouts: a simple flower and gentle waves, using subdued coral, ochre yellow, teal-blue and sage green against a cream body. No other motifs, no typography. Fine even subtle print grain and paper fibers comparable to the two references, soft contacts within layers only, strictly flat and front-facing with zero illumination effects. Center the icon on a square canvas, complete silhouette with a narrow transparent margin. Intended export about 300×300 pixels. Native transparent alpha, including negative spaces; absolutely no glow, shadow outside the object, or matte.
Place one large playful coral flower with an ochre center slightly left of center, two small sage leaf shapes, and two broad overlapping teal-blue and sage wave cutouts low across the belly, with generous cream space. Short warm ochre tassel.
notes: 實景參考：台南旅遊網 https://www.twtainan.net/zh-tw/event/newsdetail/7745/；微笑台灣 https://smiletaiwan.cw.com.tw/article/2879；食尚玩家 https://supertaste.tvbs.com.tw/travel/339039 。取白紙圓球、短吊繩、深色小圓口及民眾手繪色塊的特徵。candidate-1.png 為珊瑚紅花款，選為主圖；candidate-2.png 為淡黃花款。保留原生 alpha，候選保留生成尺寸，主圖等比輸出 300 × 300 px。
